metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.4 · 1981 · Raiders of the Lost Ark
metas.description: In 1936, archaeologist Indiana Jones is tasked by Army Intelligence to help locate a legendary ancient power, the Ark of Covenant, before the Nazis get it first.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.5 · 1984 · Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
metas.description: In 1935, Indiana Jones is tasked by Indian villagers with reclaiming a sacred stone stolen from them by a secret cult.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 8.2 · 1989 · Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
metas.description: In 1938, after his father goes missing while pursuing the Holy Grail, Indiana Jones finds himself up against the Nazis again to stop them from obtaining its powers.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.2 · 2008 · Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
metas.description: In 1957, Indiana Jones is called back into action when he becomes entangled in a Soviet plot to uncover the secret behind mysterious artifacts known as the Crystal Skulls.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.5 · 2023 · Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
metas.description: Archaeologist Indiana Jones races against time to retrieve a legendary artifact that can change the course of history.
